claims: The American Idol Season 24 (2026) Top 20 contestants are Philmon Lee, Madison Moon, Braden Rumfelt, Jake Thistle, Jesse Findling, Ruby Rae, Genevieve Heyward, Lucas Leon, Hannah Harper, Chris Tungseth, Julián Kalel, Rae, Daniel Stallworth, Abayomi, Kutter Bradley, Makiyah, Keyla Richardson, Jordan McCullough, Brooks Rosser, and Kyndal Inskeep.
Jordan McCullough, Brooks Rosser, and Kyndal Inskeep are platinum ticket winners on American Idol Season 24 (2026).
The judges of American Idol Season 24 (2026) are Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie.
KeKe Palmer and Brad Paisley joined for the Hawaii rounds as mentors on American Idol Season 24 (2026).
The Top 20 contestants of American Idol Season 24 (2026) performed at Disney's Aulani Resort and Spa in Hawaii.
American Idol Season 24 (2026) included a Top 30 "Hollywood Week" before narrowing down to the Top 20 for America's vote.
